audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts open with 'Skill' at level 1 and hand Yorick levels 6 and first item, contradicting the packet chart (Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Yorick) and the whys beside them: whys[0] says his E and ghouls chip you while you have one ability, whys[4] calls level 6 a real all-in, whys[5] calls first item your peak window. report[2].t also claims the lane is 'Yours from level 1' and report[14].t calls it a 'Favoured matchup' at a 46.93% win rate.
audit.why: 46.93% over 375 games: Yorick owns levels 1-3 and the late game, Gragas owns 6 through first item. The page currently sells the opposite.
audit.corrected: Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Yorick — one atomic group across both layers, plus the two summary strings corrected.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Gragas at 6 (E-W-Q-R) and first item; Yorick at Eulogy of the Isles and the late split.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is described only as a cage that 'traps you for the ghouls'. The decisive fact is missing: it is a destructible wall that blocks movement, so it stops Body Slam — your only engage and your only escape — and the page never gives its 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown.
audit.why: Gragas' entire pattern is one 14s dash. A wall that denies it, on a 20s cooldown at rank 1, is the interaction that decides every commit in this lane.
audit.corrected: The wall is destructible and blocks your Body Slam dash — break it or path around it; it is down 20s at rank 1. Mourning Mist (E, 12s at rank 1) is what shreds armour and steers the ghouls onto you.
sources: champ-data/_kits yorick (W 20/18/16/14/12, 'destructible wall ... will block enemy movement'; E 12/11/10/9/8)

edits.before: He out-scales you and you have to accept it. Maiden plus a full ghoul swarm shreds even your beefy HP in the side lane, and his W Dark Procession wall pins you so everything free-hits you faster than Happy Hour can heal. Don't try to 1v1 his split, you lose that grind. Use Explosive Cask to peel and to knock him off your carries in fights, and let your team answer his splitpush while you play the durable engage-and-disengage role instead of dueling him in a side lane.
edits.after: He out-scales you and you have to accept it. Maiden plus a full ghoul swarm shreds even your beefy HP in the side lane, and Dark Procession is destructible terrain that blocks Body Slam itself — walled in, you cannot dash out and everything free-hits you faster than Happy Hour heals. Don't 1v1 his split. Use Explosive Cask to peel and knock him off your carries, and let your team answer the splitpush while you play the durable engage-and-disengage role.

notes: The page's summary strings sold a losing lane as favoured — corrected report[2] and report[14] to match the 46.93% and the packet chart. Level-chart flips are proposed as one group (levels 1, 6, first item).
